notes.title: Notice of Postponement: Reboot Version Open Beta Test
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support of Warlander.



We had originally planned to begin the Open Beta Test for the reboot version in August 2025. However, in order to further refine our development schedule and enhance the overall quality, we have decided to postpone the test. We will announce the new start date as soon as it has been determined.



Our team is working hard to deliver a better gameplay experience, and we sincerely appreciate your patience and understanding. We look forward to your continued support of Warlander.



— The Warlander Development & Operations Team

notes.title: 🌟 Balance Update 🌟
notes.notes:
Greetings Warlander!

The following changes are being made in an effort to improve game balance.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png
▼Adjustments
Keep Gate
Keep Gate durability has been reduced because the previous value made using ladders as a means of gaining access to an enemy keep more difficult than intended.
 Durability: 3200 → 2000
Colossus Form (Centurion Ultimate)
The duration is being reduced so that Centurions have less impact on the result of a match that goes into overtime. 
 Duration (seconds): 15 → 12
Typhon Shield (Typhon Ultimate)
Typhon Wing’s ability to blow away enemies was proving to have minimal impact on the battlefield because it was too weak. To allow the Typhon to be effective at advancing battle lines, Typhon Wing is being adjusted so that it can no longer be blocked by a shield, and its range and blast distance are being increased.
 Can no longer be blocked by shields
 Blast distance (meters): 9 → 15
 Range (meters): 17.5 → 20
Area Heal
Area Heal was proving to be less effective than intended when compared to Heal due to the prevalence of Dispel. Area Heal’s cooldown, duration, and heal over time effect are being adjusted so that it provides more healing in a shorter time.
 Cooldown (seconds): 18 → 20
 Duration (seconds): 12 → 8
 Heal Over Time (seconds): 10/11.8/13.6/15.4/17.2 → 15/18/21/24/27
Wind Trap
Wind Trap’s cooldown and number of uses are being adjusted to give it more strategic flexibility.
 Cooldown (seconds): 20 → 22/20/20/18/18
 Uses: 1/2/3/4/5 → 3/3/4/4/5
▼Bug Fixes
 Fixed a minor known issue with Labyrinth Temple
If you have any feedback regarding this update or other game issues, please let us know.

notes.title: 🌟 Balance Update 🌟
notes.notes:
Greetings Warlander!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png
The following changes are being made in an effort to improve game balance.

Keep Gate
 Keep Gates are being made repairable because the destruction of a Keep Gate results in the constant need to deal with the threat of enemy intruders, which in turn contributes to making the game feel unfun.
 Additionally, because the Keep Gate is the last line of defense, its durability is being increased.
 Durability - 1600 ⇒ 3200
Barrage
 Barrage's burn damage against objects is being reduced due to the excessive impact it can have on a game.
 Burn Damage vs Objects - 10 ⇒ 5
Rocket Punch
 Rocket Punch's object damage is being reduced because it has made the destruction of gates and siege and artillery weapons easier than intended.
 Object Damage - 250/287.5/325/362.5/400 ⇒ 200/230/260/290/32
Judgment Strike
 Judgment Strike's ability to deal object damage and burn damage against objects is being removed due to the fact that the Arcane Art can have an excessive impact on the game despite how early it can become available.
Energy Blessing
 Energy Blessing's attack multiplier has been reduced due to the fact that it made dealing with enemies under its effect too difficult.
 Attack Multiplier ... 1.5/1.625/1.75/1.875/2 ⇒ 1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3/1.35

We've received a lot of game balance feedback from all of you, and we're aware that not everything has been covered. That's because our goal is to provide a fun game experience for all of you, and we're still deliberating how to best accomplish that.

If you have any feedback regarding this update or other game issues, please let us know.

notes.notes:
Greetings Warlander!
Here are the details of the October 7 update.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png
New Features

A new 5-team battle map "Victory Bell" will be implemented.
The number of towers in Victory Bell is five, significantly fewer than in The pentagon (the existing five-team map), making each tower more important, and the key to victory is how well you can keep your towers in place. Also, whereas the pentagon had different terrain and fortress for each team, the terrain and fortress in Victory Bell are similar for all teams.
There are three routes to attack the castle, with a battering ram and siege tower on each of the left and right lanes. The central route has no weapons, but catapults can be used to attack the central route gate. The Special Ops who cover with catapults and the Assault Squad who rush into the castle must work well together to break into the castle.
Team skills " Hymn of War" and "Battlecry" will be implemented with additional effects for squad members
Hymn of War
The amount of armor granted to all participants will change depending on the participation of squad members
1 member: 25
2 members: 85
3 members: 145
4 members: 200
Armor value upper limit 200
Squad member participation grants [Increased Natural Recovery] (buff) to members only when they are not in combat.
Without buffs: Warrior and Mage recovery limit 50%, automatic recovery rate 4%/s, time to trigger automatic recovery 10s
With buffs: Warrior and Mage recovery limit 100%, automatic recovery rate 4%/s, time to trigger automatic recovery 5s
Values are subject to adjustment.
Buffs are subject to the skill "Dispel".
Battle Cry
The duration and level of the buff for the attack power increase buff for all participants will change depending on the participation of squad members.
 1 member: buff duration 20s, buff level 1
 2 members: buff duration 70s, buff level 3
 3 members: buff duration 120s, buff level 5
 4 members: buff duration 160s, buff level 7
 Buff duration upper limit 160s
 Squad member participation grants the following buffs to squad members only
 Weapons Move up
 Building speed up
 Duration and buff level do not change depending on the number of members
 Buffs are subject to the skill "Dispel".
 With the addition of squad member effects, the UI display for team skills will be modified
 A "Portal Gate" that only members of the same team can pass through will be added to the Cleric Ult "Turret Wall".
 No bullet can pass through.
 Allied bot and alliance team members cannot pass through
 New products will be added to the shop.
 A new function "Treasure Hunt" will be implemented in the shop.
 This is a new feature that allows you to obtain random items by spending Goldin.
 You can acquire a variety of skins, including skins that have been sold in the past.
 We will also continue to add skins that can only be obtained through the Treasure Hunt.
 A new feature "Survey" will be implemented.
 A QR code linked to an external survey page will be displayed in the game.
 A survey field will be added to the Questionnaire section of the top menu to take you to the survey page.
Improvements & Changes
 Bot Commander's instructions have been adjusted.
 Key help for switching pages has been added along with the addition of scrolling operations in the store
 The icon display in the shop has been adjusted and changed to make it easier to see which categories and products are on sale.
 When an ally receiving Energy Blessing attacks an enemy, an effect and SE have been added to the reticle to indicate that the ally is attacking the Energy Blessing activator.
 Changed so that when there is an allied player (including oneself) inside the Cleric skill “Sphere Shield”, the Cleric will receive Valor points if the Sphere Shield is hit by an enemy's long-range attack.
Bug Fixes
 Fixed an issue in which all icons indicating the color of the model displayed next to the item name of modern warfare equipment were displayed in gray.
 Fixed an issue where guarding the alternate projectiles of the " Turret Wall" ballista could cause the ballista to not accept any action other than guarding.
 Fixed an issue with the "Turret Wall" where it was possible to climb and stand on it from the side.
 Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented matching from starting if you left the party at the same time you entered the matching.
 Fixed a bug that could cause unintended UI and behavior when attempting to activate the "Turret Wall" in certain positions.
 Fixed an issue where the "Turret Wall", when placed on a breakable scaffold, would sometimes remain floating in mid-air without breaking even if the scaffold was no longer there.
 Fixed a bug that allowed a robot to destroy the "Turret Wall".
 Fixed a bug in Ritual Valley A where the blue team BOT would repeatedly respawn in Tower A.
 Steam version only: Fixed a bug in which switching the control type on the character slot selection screen did not switch the key helper for skills.
 Fixed a bug that caused the microphone to automatically unmute when going to Results with the microphone muted.
 Fixed a bug where the Ult "Phoenix" sometimes did not slip past enemy bullets
 Fixed a bug that prevented Warrior Pose 27 from being the correct pose.
 Fixed a problem in which the number of occupied towers under the minimap was not updated when the tower was 80% occupied and in acquisition status.
 Fixed a problem in which the dialog box for specifying the number of boost items and color powders could not be displayed when trying to purchase them in the event store, and the items could not be purchased in bulk.
 Fixed a problem in which the targets of non-commander members did not switch after the tower was occupied when the commander sent a group of troop instructions.
 Fixed a bug in the Ritual Valley stage where the BOT commander did not give attack instructions to the siege tower route.
 Fixed a squad mission for invading an enemy castle not being accomplished when invading the castle of a team that was destroyed in a 5-team battle.
 Fixed a bug that allowed a unit to get a score for completing a unit mission after turning over when the unit was an attacking unit in a 5-team battle.
 Fixed a problem in which the fort section was not shown on the map of Ritual Valley A.
 Fixed a bug with the “Wave Blaster” skill that was sometimes causing it to incorrectly apply burning damage.
 Fixed a bug with the “Tower Rock” Arcane Art that sometimes prevented it from correctly appearing on the Map and Mini Map.
 Fixed a bug that could sometimes prevent other players from piloting a Robot if the original pilot was disconnected from the game.

 New Game Mode: Union War! Separate into player groups called Unions and aim for the top of the leaderboards.

 First, this will be introduced in a preview event three times a day (4:00 am/2:00 pm/9:00 pm UTC) from Nov 28 to Dec 12.
 Each player sets a Union Tag. Players with matching Union Tags are considered to be in the same union.

 Players with the same Union Tag are more likely to be matched in the same Battle and on the same Army.
 During the preview event, you can only select from preset Unions.

 Each player earns rank points from Battle results. The overall Union Ranking is determined by Union Points which are calculated from the rank points earned by each player belonging to the union.
 Union ranking is determined by the sum of all members' rank points, and each player's rank is multiplied by a multiplier (influence coefficient) according to his/her rank in the members' ranking.

 Members ranked 1~10 within their Union have their points tripled, while those ranked 101st and below have their points multiplied by 0.1. This means that even a union with a relatively small number of members may be able to compete with a union with a large number of members depending on the performance of its top members!

 The point system for Deploying Characters with high-ranking Titles will be changed.

 When a character respawns, this will cost Deploy Points.
 Deploy points increase over time; the later in the Battle, the more points obtained.
 Deploy points also increase when your Army’s Core is damaged. 
 A preview event for this mode will be held on the following dates (all times in UTC):

 9:00 am November 28 to 8:59 am December 1

 Major Change to Battle Rules

 The current system, which allows players to Deploy Characters with higher Title Ranks earlier by earning Valor Points, frequently resulted in the team that won the battle early on by Deploying Characters with high ranked Titles, causing the development of the game to become one-sided. Furthermore, the actions that lead to victory change depending on the situation, which makes it difficult to create a comprehensive evaluation system for earning Valor Points. This new system awards point over time, making it easier to formulate strategies for which character to Deploy at which point in time. We also hope that this system will make it easier for comebacks to occur by awarding points to Armies that have taken damage to their Cores.

 New Squad Respawn System

 You will now be able to Warp/respawn at a Squad Member's location to make it easier to act as part of a Squad.
 However, a Squad Warp or Squad respawn cannot occur under the following conditions:

 When the target Squad member is in an enemy keep
 When the target Squad member is near an enemy

 Season 3 will begin November 21, 2023!

 The top header and general menu background have been changed to a blue background, and the pattern has been updated.

 Changed the background model of the top menu.

 Changed the game logo on the title screen.

 New ★5 Cleric Title: Harvest Queen.


 New Ult Skill, Harvest Dance: Spray fruit around yourself to strengthen nearby allies. Sometimes rare glowing fruit will also appear. These sport increased effect.


 Apples: Boosts attack.

 Muscats：Boosts movement speed.

 Corn: Apply protection effect.

 New 2-Army Battle Map: Labyrinth Temple


 This underground labyrinth stage includes new elements such as movable siege weapons, pitfalls, and moving floors!

 Added new Tips to the loading screen.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/d8acb615d0c4f325e5c0bf805e949a1c825e354f.png

 All starting skills through level 4 are now accessible to new players. This is to make it easier for players to utilize high rank Titles as soon as they get them. 

 The restriction on purchasing skills on the Shop screen has been removed. Players can now purchase as many skills as they want as long as they have enough Silvings.

 Meteor Cataclysm adjusted.


 The area of effect when the Meteor Cataclysm is triggered has been adjusted so that it is more concentrated in a rectangular area in front of where it was invoked.

 The interval between invoking the Meteor Cataclysm and the meteors falling has been shortened. 

 Robot Cataclysm improved. 


 Increased the damage of melee attacks.

 The rapid fire gatling gun ranged weapon has had its damage and travel decay improved to give the Robot better ranged combat capabilities. 

 Adjusted the camera to make it easier to shoot when piloting the machine gun and cannon.

 The Cleric skill "Warp Gate" can no longer be activated on siege towers because the gate remains in the air even when the tower moves away. 

 Recovery after throwing an enemy has been reduced for the Warrior skill "Power Bomb" to make it easier to use in melee combat.

 The Magic Arrow magic shot has been adjusted.


 The Magic Arrow was generally superior in all aspects: range, fire rate, and damage, making it a versatile weapon that was not limited by any situation. In addition, its DPS is high compared to other weapons. With this update, we want to emphasize the rapid-fire aspect of the shot to maintain the usability of the weapon, while reducing the effective range and DPS to better outline the strengths and weaknesses of the weapon.

 Fire rate: 500->600

 Maximum range:100->85


 Bullet travel decay start distance: 50 -> 35

 The Fireball magic shot has been adjusted.


 The fire rate and bullet speed of Fireball has been adjusted to improve the accuracy of the weapon and the feeling of impact. All other parameters were also adjusted to match the improved fire rate. In addition, to better emphasize the importance of the immolation effect, hitstun has been eliminated but the increased rate of fire makes it easier to set opposing players on fire.

 The Revolver Cannon is a weapon that deals a certain amount of damage to both targets and opponents and can flinch opponents, but currently it is difficult to hit enemies with it and has relatively low DPS, leaving it as an underused weapon. notes.notes:
Greetings Warlander!

We've pushed a small patch today to all platforms, details are below:

Feature Improvements
The transition time from one screen to the next as well as the overall time for the War Strategy meeting phase has been shortened.

Parameter Adjustments
Adjustments will be made to Centurion's ULT Skill "Colossus Form".


 Adjusted the duration of Colossus Form from 12s to 15s.

 When Colossus Form is activated, the max HP increase is now increased from 150 to 300.
 
 Attack power increase in increased from 1.2x to 1.3x.
 
 Shortened the recovery time after activating Colossus and Roar.

The goal of the Colossus Ult is to strengthen the Warrior’s role as a tank by temporarily increasing the HP limit and attracting the attention of enemy players. However, in its current state, it was difficult to withstand attacks from multiple enemies, and its ability to survive was poorer than anticipated.

Adjustments to HP for ballistae and cannons.

 600 before reinforcement/1200 after reinforcement → 540 before reinforcement /1080 after reinforcement

This change was made because games were prone to stalemate due to the large impact of anti-siege weapons on the battle situation. In addition, there was little difference in HP between the anti-siege weapons and the defensive parameters, making it difficult to create a choice of which to destroy depending on the situation.

notes.notes:
Greetings Warlander!
Content Update 1.4.1.1166 is now available. This update includes a new map and a new practice mode, as well as gameplay improvements, balancing, and bug fixes. 

New Features

New Map
A new map, Moonlit Church has been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/7d59fd1004f85bb0ed977c3407768e47f4e92d71.png

Moonlit Church allows players to experience battles under the moonlight and features four catapults in the center which can play an important role in pushing the frontline. Additionally, siege battles utilize two routes requiring new strategies for both defense and attack.

Starting from when the May 2nd update drops until 3:00 pm UTC, 2-Army Battles will be fought exclusively on the Moonlit Temple map.

From May 3rd to May 7th, the Moonlit Temple map will be playable every 30 mins while other maps will rotate in every 60 mins.
 
Specifically, the rotation will occur in 30-minute intervals as follows: 
Dawn Bridge A → Moonlit Temple → Dawn Bridge B → Ritual Valley → Moonlit Temple

After May 8, the regular schedule will be as follows with maps rotating every 50 minutes:
Dawn Bridge A → Ritual Valley → Moonlit Temple → Dawn Bridge B → Ritual Valley → Moonlit Temple

 Map rotation order and schedule are subject to change without notice.
 If matchmaking begins just before a map rotation, there is a possibility that matchmaking will not be successful due to an insufficient number of players, etc.

Practice mode added
This single-player mode allows a player to enter a 2-Army Battle and experience the flow of the game against and alongside BOTs.

Superior Foe Battle
A feature called "Superior Foe Battle" has been added.
Normally, players will be matched with players of the same rank, but if they enter a match where there are more players of a higher rank, the character experience received after the Battle will be increased.

Cataclysm Death Penalty
Characters killed by a Cataclysm will now need to wait longer than normal to respawn.
Players can use this to restrict high level enemy characters by making it more difficult for them to be Deployed in Battle.

Opening Movie added to title screen
After a certain amount of time elapses on the title screen, a movie will play introducing users to the world of Warlander.

Additional Tutorials
An additional tutorial has been added after the tutorial on the flow of Battle explaining Cataclysms and anti-siege weaponry.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

Feature Improvements

 When the game is first launched, the player now has another set of common equipment for warriors.
 Kill Assist, as well as kills, now earn Valor points according to the Title rank difference of the enemy killed.
 When purchasing equipment from the Shop, the Perk attached to equipment is now displayed in the Shop.
 If a Mage takes damage while summoning a Familiar, the summon will be canceled.
 Familiars can now be summoned in the air.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

 To alleviate the disparity between players who have just started the game and those who have been playing for a long time and to adjust the overall game tempo, we have lowered the increase in attack power gained through customization.

notes.title: ⚔️ Content Update 1.4.0.1131 ⚔️
notes.notes:
Greetings Warlander!

Content Update 1.4.0.1131 is live! This update features a new Map, new Mercenary Customization, plus a ton of Feature Improvements, and bug fixes. 

NEW FEATURES

A new map "Dawn Bridge B" has been added!

 This Map is a twist on the existing "Dawn Bridge”.
 The entire Map is now shrouded in fog, and the overall atmosphere has changed dramatically.
 The location and number of towers, walls, and siege and anti-siege weapons have been altered, changing the flow of the battle.
 After this update goes live, the map rotation for 2-army battles will occur every hour and a half. The rotation will be “Ritual Valley” → “Dawn Bridge A” → “Dawn Bridge B.”
 The above rotation will start with the new Dawn Bridge B for 30 minutes from 12:00 to 12:30 (CEST)!
 Update times are subject to change without notice; if the update occurs after 12:30 (CEST), the first "Dawn Bridge B" will be available for play from 15:30 CEST.
 *The map rotation schedule is subject to change without notice.
 *Please note that matchmaking may take time due to an insufficient number of players if started immediately before the map rotates.

Mercenary Customization

 Skills for some Mercenaries are now possible to edit.

Daily Bonus

 A daily bonus feature has been implemented that allows players to earn one more Battle Results reward for the first Battle of the day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

FEATURE IMPROVEMENTS
Performance Optimization

 Processing load has been reduced so that the game can be played more comfortably even on low-spec PCs.

Matchmaking

 You can now see the game mode, map, and time elapsed since matchmaking began in the matchmaking lobby. 
 Improved matchmaking algorithm to ensure more equal team making.

Robot

 Previously, it was too easy to defeat Robot pilots. As such, pilots will now receive 10 points of armor per second while riding the Robot (max 200). 
 Made it possible for the Robot driver to open the gate.

Beginner Quests

 Removed beginner quests "Perform a Finisher" and "Play one 5-Army Battle."

Tutorial

 An explanation of Mercenaries is now displayed during the new player tutorial.

Valor

 You can now earn Valor points when destroying weapons with fire damage.

Map Environment Changes

 Certain objects have had their placement adjusted on the map Dawn Bridge.
 Adjusted defensive perimeters around C Tower, E Tower, and the area next to the castle (around the ladders)

Bot Behavior

 Bot behavior has been adjusted so that Bots will behave more in line with the battle situation.

Combat Fixes

 Style (Weapon Swap) Change is no longer canceled when you are struck by a melee attack.
 If an airborne player is struck by a Guard Break they will be blown back as if they were hit by a melee attack. 

Characters

 When deleting a character, you must now reconfirm even after confirming once.

Mouse Invert

 You can now invert the Mouse horizontally and vertically. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

GAMEPLAY ADJUSTMENTS

Warrior and Cleric Melee Fixes and Adjustments

 Changed the speed of some melee attacks used by the Warrior and Cleric for the following reasons:
 Fixed a problem where enemies would appear to not be hit or stunned when attacked by melee attacks.
 Fixed an issue where some attack combos could attack the enemy with no room for counterattack.
 Fixed an issue in which melee attacks could sometimes interrupt opposing melee attacks, thus reducing the importance of the Attack/Guard/Guard Break triangle.

Cleric Melee Damage Vs. Objects Adjustments

 The current damage of the Cleric’s melee damage vs objects is high, so in addition to the above adjustment to the animation speed of melee attacks, the following adjustments have been made:

Cleric melee attack damage to objects adjustments

 Normal 1…45→22
 Normal 2…45→22
 Normal 3…120→60
 Critical Strike…50→37
 Guard Break 1…15→7
 Guard Break 2…22→11
 Guard Break 3…30→15
 Jump Attack…67→33
 Jump Attack（From High）…120→60
 Dash Attack…67→33
 Back Attack…90→45

Power Bomb

 For the Warrior skill "Power Bomb", the timing between the activation of the skill and the beginning of the Super Armor has been delayed slightly in order to add more counterplay to interactions involving this Skill.

Siege and Anti-Siege

 To adjust the impact of catapults in Battle, damage taken by wooden objects set ablaze by the catapult has been reduced from 600 to 300. 
 Siege weapons now take 10 damage per second when on fire, down from 30 per second.
 Anti-siege weapon base durability has been increased from 120 to 400 as Mages were destroying them too easily.
 Changed the HP of cannons before/after reinforcement from 400/800 to 300/600, the same value as a ballista. Reload time adjusted from 3s to 2s

Centurion Balance

 The movement speed of the Legendary Warrior Title "Centurion" in Colossus Form has been reduced to 136% speed, down from 200%. This is due to the Skill potentially affecting gameplay in a network game.

Cataclysm

 The position of Cataclysm Idols for each map has been adjusted so that it appears more in line with the battle situation.

Valor Points Earning Adjustments
Valor Point acquisition has been adjusted in the following ways, in order to better maintain fairness in battle:

Kills

 The difference in Title Ranks is now factored into the number of Valor Points earned when a kill is made.

Squad Missions

The following adjustments have been made because the large number of Valor points earned from Squad missions was causing immediate Valor Level increases, leading to one-sided Battles.

 Valor Points earned for each squad mission 400/800/1200 -> 200/400/800

Adjustments have been made to the squad missions, as there was a large difference in the difficulty level between the different squad roles.

Assault Squad

 Destroy 50% or more of an enemy Core → Destroy 10% or more of an enemy Core

Castle Guard Squad

 0 Damage to your Core for 3 mins/6 mins/10 mins → 0 Damage to your Core for 5 mins/8 mins/12 mins

Special Ops Squad (Dawn Bridge A, The Pentagon)

 Dawn Bridge A: Capture 4 or more towers at the same time → Capture 5 or more towers at the same time
 The Pentagon: Capture 5 or more towers at the same time → Capture 6 or more towers at the same time

If a Battle is settled before the requirements of a Squad Mission are met, Valor Points will be awarded as soon as the Battle ends.

Valor Rank

 Along with the adjustment of Valor Points earned for kills, the Valor points required to advance to each Valor rank have also been adjusted.
 Valor Points required to advance to each Valor Level
 500/1200/2100/3200/4500 → 500/1300/2400/3800/5500


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

BUG FIXES

 Fixed a bug that caused team-making to fail in rare cases, resulting in a network error.
 Fixed a bug that sometimes allowed two players to acquire a Cataclysm at the same time.
 Fixed an issue where the Robot self-destructs attack damage would not destroy Siege Weapons.
 Fixed an issue where the "Firewall" skill would not hit an enemy who was guarding.
 Fixed an issue where colliding with a shield while using the skill Rushdown would not detonate a Wind mine.
 When attempting to set a squad marker while riding a siege weapon, the marker will now be placed correctly at the crosshair. 
 Fixed a bug that prevented Crystal Defender from responding to users on Ballistae.
 Fixed a problem where Lightning Shock would not hit enemies on ballistae.
 Camera option settings are now applied when operating the Robot's gunner seat.
 Fixed issue where resuscitate wouldn’t work sometimes on inclines.
 Fixed a bug where quests for earning Valor Points, which are exclusive to each class, could be earned by other classes.
 Fixed a bug where a dash slash or guard break would rarely display the prompt for a Critical Strike.
 Fixed an issue where Mercenaries were not customized appropriately compared to their CP count.
 Fixed a bug where guard behavior may be incorrect for the following Skills and Familiars:
 Crystal Defender
 Wind Trap 
 Magic Napalm
 Anti-Siege Weapon: Cannon
 Rocket Punch
 Rocket
 Other minor bug fixes

notes.notes:
Greetings Warlander!

We've released a patch with changes and improvements to gameplay, event functions, UI/UX, training area, and skill balance, as well as a large number of bug fixes.  

Change of season duration

 The end date of the current Season 0 has been changed.
 Before change: Ends April 19, 2023, at 9:00 (UTC)
 Now: April 25, 2023, 9:00 (UTC)

Additional Functions

 Event rules have been added that only certain classes can participate.
 Elemental Fury will be held under this rule, in which only Mages can participate.
 We hope you will enjoy a different kind of long-distance warfare-oriented Warlander!

Leaver Penalties

 Penalties will now be given for exiting from the menu or leaving a game unattended.
 Players who do not finish a match properly will not be able to enter the match for a certain period of time.
 Players who are repeatedly doing things that are subject to penalties will have their penalties extended and will be restricted from matching for a longer period of time.
 We will continue to add new ways of detecting game abandonment (AFK) to penalize.

Voice Macros

 Voice macros will no longer be notified to other players if used multiple times in a row.
 When using voice macros or markers in succession, callouts and voice macros will no longer play continuously on other players' screens.

Beginner Quests
Improved the content of beginner quests.

 Changed the conditions for clearing steps 1-4.
 If there is a quest with changed conditions for a step that is currently in progress, the progress with the old conditions will be reset.
 If there is a Quest with changed conditions in an already-cleared step, it will remain clear.
 This change does not revert the cleared step to an uncleared state.

Keybindings
The following key configurations can now be changed:

 Entering additional skills
 Cancel a Skill
 Re-Deploy

UI/UX Improvements

 New item and title icons now disappear when the cursor is held over them.
 Tooltips for Familiars now display attack power against humans and objects.
 Changed so that Glamours already installed are also displayed in the list of equipment appearance changes.
 The range of emotes that can be set for each voice macro has been increased.

Adjustments to Training Area

 BOTs with higher title ranks have been placed in the training area.
 Allied BOTs in the training area now participate in team skills.
 The behavior of BOTs in the training area when blown away while in guard status has been changed.
 Before: After being blown away, the BOT will return to its original position by normal movement.
 After change: After being blown away, the BOT will return to its original position while guarding.

Gameplay adjustments
Opening Gates

 When an enemy player is near and outside the gate, the gate cannot be opened.
 The judgment of opening and closing the gate according to the position of the enemy and the player attempting to open the gate will be as follows.

The gate can be opened.

 Opener: Inside the gate -- Enemy: Inside the gate
 Opener: Outside of the gate -- Enemy: Inside of the gate

Cannot open the gate

notes.title: 🌟 Warlander - Prepare for release! 🌟
notes.notes:
Greetings Warlander!

The time has come!
The time has finally come for the world to Sing Together in the Warland! 

Next Tuesday the 24th of January at 17:00 (5 PM) CET, Warlander releases officially on Steam.    
To those of you that have been battling bugs and fortifying features over the last few months, we salute you. Warlander would not be where it is today without your patience, loyalty, and undying support.

Built to the core as a multiplayer game Warlander will feature up to 100 players in a single battle and will be released to a global audience. For us to achieve victory it’s crucial that we continue our community-focused development with a transparent look at the Warlander PC release, so that we are all properly prepared to help make Warlander not only a success but also a contender for the top of the leaderboard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

A Call to War!
To help the Warlander PC release be as successful as possible, we ask YOU, our dedicated community for your continued support. The best way to help Warlander in the next days and weeks is to play Warlander, as well as continue to provide us with your fantastic feedback. 

On top of that, our visibility on Steam relies on an algorithm that you can help boost by wishlisting and following Warlander, writing a review about your experience with the game and your time within our community, and by reaching out to us directly when there is something frustrating you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

Welcome to Warlander!
On behalf of Toylogic and PLAION, we welcome all sword slashers, siege smashers, and castle crashers to join us from day one to set the tone for our fledgling player base to grow and prosper over the weeks, months, and years to come. 

Before we get ahead of ourselves and look too far into the future, we must take a look at the upcoming release and clarify what to expect as an early player of Warlander. 
Please keep in mind the following four factors as matchmaking kicks in officially for the first time and we start the process of welcoming new players into the Warland. With the global release, Warlander will be home to players from all over the world, and we understand the necessity to match regionally for the best possible ping, but also that queue time, skill/experience-based matching, and playing with a full match of players are all important aspects of your expectations as a player. 

As the first servers are created, please be patient with the process, as you may initially have similar matchmaking results to the Closed Beta, meaning that there may be times when you are matched with players from other regions, have a higher queue time, are matched with players of a higher or lower skill and experience level, and/or have matches with bots, especially at non-peak hours. This is expected and we ask that you make the best of it as we fine-tune the matchmaking to offer the best results moving forward. 
  
As the player base grows the fine-tuning process will begin where we will tweak the settings to best support having full, regional, skill-based matches, and ideally with a reasonable queue time. From there we will look at popular regions and based on player numbers, continue to roll out further regional support.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png

Squad up with us!
Community is not a buzzword for us, it is our passion and the driving force to make Warlander the best possible game it can be, so if you haven’t already joined us in Discord or followed our other channels, now is the time. 

❤️ Discord
💙 Twitch

💛 Twitter Japan
💚 TikTok

And finally, while Warlander can be fun solo queuing, it can also be played in parties of four players and there is really nothing more satisfying than playing with a full party where the heals, shields and damage are all working in a finely tuned and coordinated rhythm. So rally your friends, build alliances and we’ll see you in the Warland, as we Sing Together and charge to war!

Sincere thanks for your continued love and support. It means the world to us.

notes.title: Warlander - End of Open Beta & Release Information
notes.notes:
Greetings Warlander!

We are very happy to finally share the details that you have all been waiting for, in this Warlander news update. 

Over the past couple of months, you have provided valuable support and feedback throughout the Open Beta and have shown impressive patience while waiting for news, so to honor that, rather than share a wall of sentiment of how appreciative we are, we will get right into the details. Our appreciation is shared in detail at the end. ːsteamthumbsupː
    
END OF OPEN BETA
The Open Beta will come to an end this Friday, November 18 (5PM JST / 9AM CET). We wanted to give you guys a chance to play a few more rounds before we close the Beta, and for those of you that haven’t played 25 games yet, this is your opportunity to get in and secure your Open Beta rewards. We will be hosting a Happy Hour on Thursday Evening (CET), where we will be jumping in with you guys for some final slashes and bashes. Stay tuned to Discord Events for details. 

As a reminder, Open Beta progress will be wiped.

CONTINUED PLAY – CLOSED BETA
We had originally planned to not have any down-time after the Open Beta, but that will unfortunately not be the case. 

For those of you (like us 😊) that cannot wait for the PC Release to play again, we’re working on setting up a Closed Beta for mid December to collect feedback, suggestions, and bug reports on the PC Release build. Stay tuned for participation details.

EARLY ACCESS
We have decided to drop the Early Access phase and go directly into the official PC Release. The reason for this is that we chose to dedicate the time and effort that it would take to set up the Early Access version of Warlander and put that time and effort into the release. Not much changes with this, as you will still have the opportunity to test and provide feedback on monetization and other core features at release.  

PC RELEASE
Warlander will release on PC on the 24th of January 2023. The reason for the push into January is that essentially, you guys were too good at your job. 😊 Meaning, we received so much fantastic feedback, suggestions, and bug reports around topics that we want to consider for release, that we had to take a step back and reevaluate the timing. We’re very excited to be at the home stretch and can’t wait to officially release Warlander to the world.   

CONSOLE RELEASE
Our Gen 9 Console (PlayStation®5 and Xbox Series X|S) Release is now officially planned for April.  

OPEN BETA REWARDS RECAP
As a reminder, we have finalized our Open Beta rewards. With the end of the Open Beta this Friday, make sure you get your games in so you don’t miss out!

Open Beta Balance and Improvement Patch - 0.8.5.580

Greetings Warlander!
Our next balance and improvement patch is now available! 
This includes balance adjustments, as well as some improvements based on your feedback, including adding a Report Player button to the Support screen, adding an option to turn ON/OFF camera shake, adding server selection to the options menu (players may now select the server they wish to prioritize for matchmaking - Please keep in mind that this may affect queue times), and title acquisition cutscenes can now be skipped.
 
Join the discussion in Discord. https://discord.gg/playwarlander

Improvements to the 2-Army Battle Map
Previously the catapult area and the central area were connected, easily allowing an army that captured the central area to also capture the catapult shortly afterward, making it difficult for opposing armies to mount a comeback.

Therefore, based on community feedback, as well as data obtained from the OBT, we have now separated the central area and the catapult area topographically and added new towers to the catapult routes.

We believe that this clarifies the role of each route and changes how each route influences the overall battle. Please give the map changes a try and let us know what you think. 

Game Rules

 Added a new mechanic that determines the spawn point of the Cataclysmic Idol based on the battle situation and player locations. 
 In order to increase the number of Valor Points earned by Catapult operators, we have increased the amount of Valor Points gained when destroying Ballistas and Cannons.
 New objectives for each Squad Role
 Assault Squads: Damage an enemy Core (more Valor Points received than Spec Ops Squads and Castle Guard that do the same)
 Spec Ops Squads: Damage an enemy Core/defeat enemies near the catapult/defeat enemies around your Castle
 Castle Guard Squads: Defeat enemies around the castle (more Valor Points received than Assault and Spec Ops Squads that do the same)
 Adjusted the number of Valor Points earned from 800 to 1000 for each unit mission completed by Special Ops Squads.
 Added a feature that allows a player to instantly Redeploy after a certain amount of time has passed from their death.
 Fixed an issue in 2-Army Battles where players could earn more Valor points than usual by destroying and rebuilding the ladder attached to the wooden fort on the stone bridge.


Robot

 Sped up melee attack slightly
 Machine gun damage increased from 20 to 30
 Cannon damage increased from 60 to 100


Hymn of War

 Shortened casting time.


UI/HUD

 Improved HUD for Core HP display at the top center of the screen.
 Added an animation for when the Core is struck by an attack.
 Added a button on the support screen that leads to the Report Player page.
 Added an option to turn ON/OFF camera shake.

 Reversed camera controls selected in options are disregarded when using the mouse.
 Other minor UI/HUD improvements.

 Fixed a bug in which key configuration changes were not reflected in the voting HUD, basic control HUD, or key prompts.

Thanks for your continued feedback and support!
